text:
Sing, my wounded one
+
+Cervantes
+
+
+though it is late, it is night,
+
+and you cannot.
+
+
+Sing as though nothing were happening.
+
+
+Nothing happens

translation.title: Sing, My Wounded One…
translation.editorial_note: The isolated Cervantes is preserved as it appears in the source, between address and impossibility; the final nada turns consolation into literal nothingness.
